import pytest
from calendar_core import find_meeting_time
from calendar_core.slots import Event, overlaps, free_slots


def test_issue_example():
    """Example find_meeting_time([[Event(540,600)],[Event(600,660)]],30,540,720) returns (660,690)."""
    result = find_meeting_time([[Event(540, 600)], [Event(600, 660)]], 30, 540, 720)
    assert result == (660, 690)  # 660 + 30 = 690


def test_issue_empty_calendars():
    """Return the earliest (start, start+duration) inside [day_start, day_end) where nobody has an event."""
    result = find_meeting_time([[], []], 30, 540, 720)
    assert result == (540, 570)  # 540 + 30 = 570


def test_issue_back_to_back():
    """Events are half-open, so a meeting may start exactly when someone's event ends."""
    result = find_meeting_time([[Event(540, 600)]], 30, 540, 720)
    assert result == (600, 630)  # 600 + 30 = 630


def test_issue_clipped_outside():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped."""
    result = find_meeting_time([[Event(480, 560)]], 30, 540, 720)
    assert result == (560, 590)  # 560 + 30 = 590; clipped busy is 540-560


def test_issue_unsorted_overlapping():
    """Each calendar is a list of Event in any order, possibly overlapping."""
    calendars = [[Event(620, 680), Event(540, 600)], [Event(590, 630)]]
    result = find_meeting_time(calendars, 30, 540, 720)
    assert result == (680, 710)  # 680 + 30 = 710; merged busy is 540-680


def test_issue_no_slot():
    """Return None if there is no such time."""
    result = find_meeting_time([[Event(540, 720)]], 30, 540, 720)
    assert result is None


def test_issue_exact_fit():
    """Return the earliest (start, start+duration) inside [day_start, day_end) -- exact-size gap fits."""
    result = find_meeting_time([[Event(540, 600)]], 120, 540, 720)
    assert result == (600, 720)  # 600 + 120 = 720


def test_issue_one_minute_too_long():
    """Return None if there is no such time -- gap one minute short does not fit."""
    result = find_meeting_time([[Event(540, 600)]], 121, 540, 720)
    assert result is None  # free gap is 720 - 600 = 120 < 121


def test_issue_zero_duration():
    """Duration must be a positive integer, otherwise raise ValueError (zero)."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        find_meeting_time([[]], 0, 540, 720)


def test_issue_negative_duration():
    """Duration must be a positive integer, otherwise raise ValueError (negative)."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        find_meeting_time([[]], -15, 540, 720)


def test_issue_noninteger_duration():
    """Duration must be a positive integer, otherwise raise ValueError (non-integer)."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        find_meeting_time([[]], 30.5, 540, 720)


def test_contract_overlaps_back_to_back():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)) is False


def test_contract_free_slots_sorted():
    """free_slots returns the gaps inside [day_start, day_end) as (start, end) tuples sorted by start."""
    result = free_slots([Event(620, 680), Event(540, 600)], 540, 720, 1)
    assert result == [(600, 620), (680, 720)]  # gaps: 620-600=20, 720-680=40
